t: A long-range radio chip for LoRa, fast FLRC, and other radio types.
steps: Buy the Wio-LR2021 Dev Kit from Seeed Studio, or a Waveshare or Elecrow module.
Attach the antennas before you power on the radio.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the RadioLib library.
Open a RadioLib LR2021 example for sending and another for receiving.
Load one onto each of two boards.
Watch the serial monitor as packets arrive.
Try Meshtastic firmware next for a ready-made mesh.
meta: Open Board. From $6.90. A few stores.
